title: Frozen Code Waterfall
description: A surreal close-up of a woman's face partially formed from stone and covered in Greek and Latin letters, with her left eye containing a miniature waterfall scene inside the iris. A large icy waterfall cascades from her forehead and hair over the right side of her face, melting into a swirling turquoise pool below with icicles and more floating symbols.
prompt: surreal painting of a woman's face emerging from dark stone, her skin covered in floating Greek letters and symbols, bright green eyes with a tiny cascading waterfall visible inside the iris, large icy waterfall flowing from her forehead and hair down the right side of her face with icicles, water pouring into a swirling emerald pool at the bottom with more symbols and ice, dark moody atmosphere, detailed textures
